LightningComponentBundle.description: On-record Deal analysis: prompts, and quote compare once a quote has line items.

property.name: showPrompts
property.label: Show deal prompts
property.description: Next-step cards (discount, quantity, USB-C). Keep on for the header rail.

property.name: showCompare
property.label: Show quote compare
property.description: List-vs-quote and revision compare. Off for the Quote header; on for the Quote compare tab and Opportunity header.
